Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-08T09:05Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts` (`createConsoleStaticPlugin`, about `:605`) ⇒ `domain:cli`; rationale: that lane's.

- **Grade p3 stands:** hosted cloud already has an edge cache (objectstack-ai/cloud PR #2694). This is self-hosted load time.
- **The rule:** `immutable` only for Vite hash-shaped names, gated as cloud#2694 gates. The HTML shell and SPA fallback stay revalidated. The two stable-named maplibre files get a short lifetime plus a validator. Sibling: objectstack-ai/cloud#2697 fixes the same trap on the control plane's `_headers`.
- **Pins:** as the card says, with the ablation.

Claim: PM loop round 1
Session: `session_01BmsuLyUeuG5CNpZFMH1jzS`
Account: `os-elon-musk` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-22237-console-asset-cache`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-22237`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#1`
File surface: `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts` (`createConsoleStaticPlugin`'s static-file arm, about `:676`), a new test beside it under `packages/cli/src/utils/`, and `.changeset/22237-*.md` (`@objectstack/cli` patch). Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default (opus)`. `dispatch-gates --tier` prints "no path-derived mandate"; the hash-shape gate and the stable-named exception are design judgment, so this is not a mechanical card.
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts` (`createConsoleStaticPlugin`) produces the missing lifetime and validator | the hosted control plane's edge cache covers hosted deployments only; for self-hosted, none | every self-hosted console load reaches it; it is used today (self-hosted deployments)
Thread-read: 6056523960
Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts` (REST file lists of all 14 open PRs, read in this round). Lane queue sibling #22225 also needs `console.ts` (its 404 page) and serves behind this card. Fold-or-serial answer: SERIAL, because gate ① fails (two defects with two fixes: a cache lifetime, and a missing-Console page). Lane siblings in flight: #22310 and #22190, disjoint.
